subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is perplexed by the dead bodies with no entrance or exit wounds and no evidence of foul play.
source_quote: Grygum is perplexed: dead bodies with no entrance or exit wounds, no evidence of foul play, just dead bodies.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is known for his fondness of novels and has read Milo Goodbarrel’s book detailing the events surrounding the war of the dragon.
source_quote: Daz, known for his fondness of novels, reads voraciously and has managed to get a copy of Milo Goodbarrel’s book detailing the events surrounding the war of the dragon.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz watches two assassins strike a Duergar man with glowing weapons and wonders if they are psychic weapons.
source_quote: As Daz watches, two assassins, wearing face coverings and wielding glowing weapons, strike the other man. "Psychic weapons?" he wonders.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz utters mystical words and causes motes of light to appear above his hand, launching magic missiles at an assassin.
source_quote: When Daz utters the mystical words, motes of light appear above his hand, and three fingers point at one of the assassins. A silent rush of air accompanies the flight of the magic missiles...

subject: Daz
fact: Daz speaks the words for scorching rays, feels intense heat, and launches fiery energy at an assassin while Zalthir’s darkness hides the flash.
source_quote: Daz speaks the words for scorching rays and feels the rush of intense heat as the fiery energy is manifested. He points with his index finger, uses his thumb to sight, squints, and lets the rays loose...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir casts Darkness to cover the area and mutters that area-of-effect spells are useful because he can't see.
source_quote: Zalthir covers the area with Darkness. "I can't see. And this is why area of effect spells are useful," he mutters.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is uncertain if they made the right decision in intervening in the assassination.
source_quote: Zalthir stares at the merchant and the dead assassins. Zalthir is uncertain if they made the right decision.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir finds a charcoal drawing of the Duergar merchant on one of the assassins' corpses and presents it to him.
source_quote: Zalthir scrutinizes him and concludes that Holl may not have been lying... He presents it to the Duergar.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir finds coins, bloodstained gloves, and a box of scented candles among the assassins' corpses and passes the candles to Thorin.
source_quote: Zalthir starts to rifle through the assassins' corpses and finds some coins, a pair of bloodstained gloves, and a box of candles. He notices they have a pleasant smell and passes them to Thorin.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is exasperated by the layered factions and wants to be his own faction.
source_quote: Thorin is exasperated and almost shouts, "I am sorry, I can't deal with these factions. I can't keep track of who we are working for and which faction we are double-crossing. I want to be my faction."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin weighs a gold badge given by Gartokkar and asks Daz how much gold it is.
source_quote: Gartokkar hands out some gold badges. Thorin weighs it in his hands. Daz turns to him and asks, "How much gold is this?"

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks Gartokkar what the rights and responsibilities of being an agent are.
source_quote: "What are the rights and responsibilities for this position?" growls Thorin, outraged to be working for a dragon.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar reveals that Themberchaud thinks the Keepers of the Flame work for him, but in truth, he works for them.
source_quote: Gartokkar smiles conspiratorially, "Themberchaud thinks we work for him. What Themberchaud doesn't realize is that he works for us."

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar explains that the Keepers of the Flame lost the red dragon egg that would hatch Themberchaud’s replacement, and that Themberchaud doesn’t know about it.
source_quote: We lost face when the Gray Ghosts stole the valuable red dragon egg that would hatch Themberchaud’s replacement... He doesn’t know.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar tells Thorin that Themberchaud will eventually "move on" because he wants to see more of the world.
source_quote: Eventually, the Dragon moves on because he wants to see more of the world.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders whether the overweight red dragon Themberchaud could survive in the wild, having forgotten how to hunt.
source_quote: Zalthir is stunned. He’s never seen such a thing... And then, he wonders whether this red dragon could survive in the wild. It is so pampered that it probably has forgotten how to hunt.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud breathes fire in a circle around the cavern and laughs when nobody dies or screams.
source_quote: The dragon bellows, "If I catch anyone spying, I will kill them." And with that, he breathes fire in a circle around the cavern. When nobody dies or screams, the dragon laughs.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud asks Daz if he is from Menzoberranzan and laughs when Daz says yes.
source_quote: The dragon asks if Daz is from Menzoberranzan... Daz says he is. The dragon laughs, "Excellent! You have no family associations and nobody that can be blackmailed."

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud declares the group his agents and whispers that their first mission is to do whatever the Keepers of the Flame ask, but report to him first.
source_quote: The dragon whispers, "Your first mission is to do whatever the Keepers of the Flame ask you to, but report to Themberchaud first."

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir overhears Daz and asks Grygum if Themberchaud plays chess, recalling Milo Goodbarrel’s memoirs.
source_quote: Zalthir overhears Daz and asks Grygum, "Do you think this dragon also plays chess? According to Milo Goodbarrel’s memoirs, chess played a significant role in negotiating with the metallic dragons."

subject: Themberchaud's replacement
fact: The Keepers of the Flame stole the red dragon egg that would hatch Themberchaud’s replacement, but Themberchaud is unaware of its existence.
source_quote: We lost face when the Gray Ghosts stole the valuable red dragon egg that would hatch Themberchaud’s replacement.

subject: Droki's identity
fact: Gartokkar identifies Droki as an agent of the Grey Ghosts, the same person Errde Blackskull is looking for, but his true allegiance remains unconfirmed.
source_quote: We have identified an agent of the Grey Ghosts. His name is Droki.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters that they are double agents or triple agents, working for the Stone Guards and the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: Grygum, standing next to Thorin, mutters, "I suppose we are double agents, or is it triple agents? We work for the Stone Guards and the Keepers of the Flame."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz replies that the faction thinks they are working for them, but whether they do is up to them.
source_quote: Daz, who has experience with the twisted, machiavellian politics of the Drow, replies, "The faction thinks we are working for them. Whether we do is up to us."

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir watches the Duergar merchant become invisible after thanking them.
source_quote: Zalthir watches as the Duergar becomes invisible.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir offers to create an illusion of whale sounds for Thorin.
source_quote: Zalthir chuckles, "I could create that illusion for you."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, "God, what I wouldn’t do for a bath and listening to whale sounds."
source_quote: The dwarf smiles, "Scented candles!" And then he says, "God, what I wouldn’t do for a bath and listening to whale sounds."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum pushes the first assassin’s corpse into the water.
source_quote: Just then, Zalthir hears a body falling into the water. Grygum has pushed the first corpse into the water.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir helps push the second assassin’s corpse into the water.
source_quote: Zalthir agrees and helps push the other body into the water.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar hands out gold badges and holy symbols of Laduguer to the group.
source_quote: Let me give you this holy symbol of Laduguer and these gold pins featuring Themberchaud’s profile.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar threatens to turn the group over to the Stone Guards if they refuse to accept the agent role.
source_quote: Well we will turn you over to the Stone Guards.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar enumerates potential transgressions committed by Thorin that could warrant punitive action under Gracklstugh law.
source_quote: Let me enumerate a list of potential transgressions that the dwarf, Thorin, has committed, which could warrant significant punitive action within the laws of Gracklstugh.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir reflects that having invisible ruthless guards helps make the city peaceful and wonders if such a regime could be implemented.
source_quote: Zalthir reflects on the city's quiet and how the monks would be astounded at how peaceful it could be. "Having invisible ruthless guards helps." He wonders if such a regime could be implemented.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin has picked up the peculiar antipathy towards dragons that giants have, and Themberchaud is triggering him.
source_quote: Having lived with giants, Thorin has picked up the peculiar antipathy towards dragons that giants have. And this red dragon is triggering him.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud tells Gartokkar to give the group gold badges and commands the rest to follow Gartokkar’s orders.
source_quote: Gartokkar, come... Give these humanoids some of the gold badges... And the rest of you do what Gartokkar says.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud asks Zalthir if he is a gold dragonborn and says he never liked gold dragons.
source_quote: The dragon turns to Zalthir, "You are a gold dragonborn?" "No, a bronze." "Good. I never liked gold dragons."

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders if Daz is lying about being from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Zalthir wonders as well. Daz says he is. But Zalthir isn’t convinced that is the truth.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says, "I think gathering intelligence is just as important," dismissing Jimjar’s suggestion to leave.
source_quote: Daz dismisses him, "I think gathering intelligence is just as important."

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar asks when they will be able to leave and shrugs when Daz says they should stay.
source_quote: Jimjar has made a few friends and asks - "When do you expect us to be able to leave?"... Jimjar shrugs and slumps into one of the beds. He sighs, "Very well."

source_quote: Zalthir watches as the Duergar becomes invisible. "Convenient."

subject: Daz

source_quote: "Wererats," thinks Daz.

subject: Daz

source_quote: "And perhaps that’s why," Daz thinks, "he’s being attacked."
